kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: How Trump's attacks on voting system integrity might affect upcoming elections
wire.summary: Election law expert Rick Hasen explains Trump's interference in the midterms, including threatening local officials with criminal prosecution unless they strike alleged noncitizens from voter rolls.

wire.title: Why local officials are feeling 'on edge' as election day approaches
wire.summary: Al Schmidt is the chief election official in the state of Pennsylvania. President Trump's insults put him in danger during the 2020 ballot count. Now Schmidt talks about preparing for the midterms.

wire.title: Supreme Court upholds pause on Trump's anti-trans prison policy
wire.summary: The Supreme Court ruled Wednesday that the Trump administration has to continue providing gender-affirming care to inmates in federal prisons as litigation on efforts to change the policy continues.

wire.title: New human data hints at psychedelics' potential to combat inflammation
wire.summary: Lab studies have shown that psychedelics like psilocybin can lower inflammation and may be protective for a range of illnesses. Now, researchers are publishing some of the first data in humans that signals this holds potential for patients with neurodegenerative diseases like Parkinson's disease.

wire.title: Sentenced to death at 17, at 68, quilt artist receives solo museum exhibition
wire.summary: A quilt artist who spent decades on death row now has his first solo exhibit at the Grand Rapids Art Museum.

wire.title: Israel detains dozens of Americans, including a congressional candidate, in West Bank
wire.summary: Democratic congressional candidate Brad Lander along with about 80 American and Israeli rabbis and activists were helping Palestinian olive harvesters when they were detained by Israeli forces.

wire.title: Trump leans into unprecedented power ahead of midterm elections
wire.summary: Less than two weeks before the election, Trump continues to crash through barriers that he wouldn't dare cross in his first term.

wire.title: DOJ's noncitizen voter list is unreliable, officials say. And, U.S. pollution rises
wire.summary: The Justice Department's "likely" noncitizen voter list in California is "unreliable," according to officials. And, the United Nations reports a major increase in U.S. climate pollution.

wire.title: Russia releases imprisoned U.S. citizen Stephen Hubbard following Trump's request
wire.summary: The announcement of Hubbard's release came as talks got underway between Putin and White House envoy Steve Witkoff in Saint Petersburg focused on the latest U.S. efforts to end the war in Ukraine.

wire.title: 2025 policing trend: Fewer serious crimes, more minor arrests
wire.summary: Arrests for more minor offenses, including vagrancy, rose in the U.S., even as violent crime rates dropped to historic lows, according to an analysis from criminal justice reform advocacy group FWD.us

wire.title: Russia says it is ready to resume talks with Ukraine and US to end war
wire.summary: The announcement came after Russian President Vladimir Putin met US President Donald Trump's special envoy Steve Witkoff in St Petersburg.

wire.title: Macron accuses foreign leaders of exploiting French riots
wire.summary: The comment is an apparent swipe at Benjamin Netanyahu and Donald Trump, who both face elections in coming weeks.

wire.title: Australian MP loses both legs after alleged car attack, husband says
wire.summary: Her alleged attacker, 43-year-old Brendan Nugent, faces multiple charges and appeared in court for the first time on Wednesday.

wire.title: Elon Musk confirms he is considering merging Tesla and SpaceX
wire.summary: Musk says special committees within both companies have been formed to look at a possible mega-merger.

wire.title: Pakistan arrests man wanted by US over $126m postage fraud case
wire.summary: Faheem Akram allegedly sold more than 5 million fake postage labels for a fixed price of $2 a piece.

wire.title: Gambia to pay victims of Yahya Jammeh's rule from proceeds of his seized US mansion
wire.summary: The Gambia has confirmed receiving $2.5m from the sale of the house in Maryland.
